properties.statement: A checked arithmetic result succeeds exactly when it fits in the signed 64-bit range, and it returns the input value unchanged.
properties.lean_statement: ∀ (value result : Int), Esm.Rewrite.Metaparameters.checked value = .ok result ↔ Esm.Document.JNum.InInt64 value ∧ result = value

properties.statement: Metaparameter division succeeds exactly when the divisor is nonzero and a signed 64-bit integer quotient multiplies back to the dividend.
properties.lean_statement: ∀ (a b q : Int), Esm.Rewrite.Metaparameters.divide a b = .ok q ↔ b ≠ 0 ∧ q * b = a ∧ Esm.Document.JNum.InInt64 q
